subject.title: Seed design system for OpenClaw Windows Hub

question: Should `.agents/design/` become an upstream design authority for the Windows app, or remain a derived reference whose canonical behavior is the shipping WinUI and Reactor implementation?
rationale: Either hierarchy is technically possible, but it determines how future agents resolve conflicts and who must keep two representations synchronized; repository intent cannot be inferred from the contributor's latest wording alone.

options.title: Keep native behavior canonical
options.body: Describe the catalog as a derived, non-shipping reference and require it to follow observed WinUI and Reactor behavior, with an explicit synchronization owner.

options.title: Approve design-first authority
options.body: Accept the catalog as the upstream design authority, but assign ownership and add enforceable parity, theme, and update expectations before merge.

options.title: Decline the repository catalog
options.body: Keep design guidance beside the shipping UI or in the external Colophon ecosystem rather than adding a parallel repository authority.

recommendation.title: Keep native behavior canonical
recommendation.body: Describe the catalog as a derived, non-shipping reference and require it to follow observed WinUI and Reactor behavior, with an explicit synchronization owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Their repeated work on the native timeline and current composer contract makes them the strongest available code-history owner for evaluating whether this authority model matches the shipping UI.
